senses.gloss: य॑द्-अ॑हर् य॑द् अ॑हर् acc. ind. on which day, ŚBr.
यदा॑ See p. 844, col. 1.
यद = यद् (only in the form यदम् at the end of an adverbial comp.) g. शरद्-आदि.
याद in comp. for यादस्.
यदा—निका॑मम् ind. when it pleases, ŚBr.
यदा—वाज-दावरी f. pl. N. of a Sāman, PañcavBr.
य॑द् m. = पुरुष, Tattvas.
याद् (only pr. p. Ā. या॑दमान), to be closely united or connected with (instr.), meet in (loc.), RV. (The meaning of this root, as well as its connection with the following words, is very doubtful.)
यद्—अन्न mfn. eating which food, R.
यद्—अभावे ind. in the absence or in default of which, MW.
यद्—अर्थ mfn. having which object or intention, BhP.
यद्—अर्थम् (अम्), ind. on which account, for which purpose, wherefore, why, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
as, since, because, whereas, ib.
यद्—अर्थे (ए), ind. on which account, for which purpose, wherefore, why, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
as, since, because, whereas, ib.
यद्—अवधि ind. since which time, Bhām.
यद्—अवसान mfn. terminating in which, Lāṭy.
यद्—अशन mfn. = -अन्न, R.
यद्—अशनीय n. anything that may be eaten, ĀpGṛ.
यद्—आत्मक mfn. having which essence or existence, BhP.
यद्—आर्षेय mfn. of which divine descent, L.
यद्—ऋच्छ mf(आ)n. spontaneous, accidental, ĀpGṛ.
यद्—ऋच्छा f. self-will, spontaneity, accident, chance (ibc. or ˚च्छया ind. spontaneously, by accident, unexpectedly), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in gram.) See -शब्द, below
यद्-ऋच्छा , यद्-गोत्र &c. See p. 844, col. 3.
यद्—ऋच्छया ind., spontaneously, by accident, unexpectedly
यद्—ऋच्छ—तस् ind. by chance, accidentally, BhP.
यद्—ऋ˚च्छाभिज्ञ m. a voluntary or self-offered witness, Nār.
यद्—ऋच्छ—मात्र-तस् ind. only quite by accident, Kathās.
यद्—ऋच्छ—लाभ-संतुष्ट mfn. satisfied with obtaining what comes spontaneously, easily satisfied, Bhag.
यद्—ऋच्छ—शब्द m. ‘chance-word’, a word neither derived from authority nor possessing meaning, Śiś.
यद्—ऋच्छ—संवाद m. accidental or spontaneous conversation, Uttarar.
यद्—ऋ˚च्छिक m. (scil. पुत्र) a son who offers himself for adoption, MW.
यादृच्छिक mf(ई)n. (fr. यदृच्छा) spontaneous, accidental, unexpected, MBh.; Daś. &c.
having no particular object, acting at random, BhP.
यादृच्छिक m. an officiating priest who does as he pleases, W.
यद्—गोत्र mfn. belonging to which family, ChUp.
यद्—देवत (ŚrS.) or यद्—देवत्य᳙ (ŚBr.), mfn. having which godhead or divinity.
यद्—देवत (ŚrS.) or यद्—देवत्य᳙ (ŚBr.), mfn. having which godhead or divinity.
यद्—द्वंद्व n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
यद्—धेतोस् (for -हेतोस्) ind. from which reason, on which account, BhP.
यद्—बल mfn. of which strength or power, MBh.
यद्—भविष्य mfn. one who says, ‘what will be will be’, Fatalist (N. of a fish), Hit.
यद्—भूयस् (ibc.) the greatest part (˚सा ind. See col. 2)
यद्—भूयसा ind., ‘for the most part’, See तद्
यद्—भूयस्—कारिन् mfn. doing anything for the most part, L.
यद्—रूप-विचार m. N. of wk.
यद्—वत् ind. in which way, as (correlative of तद्-वत् and एवम्), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
यद्—वद mfn. talking anything, saying no matter what, L.
यद्—वाहिष्ठीय n. (fr. यद् वाहिष्ठम्, the first two words of RV. v, 25, 7) N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr. (also अग्नेर्-यद्व्˚).
यद्-विद्वस् mfn. knowing which, JaimUp.
यद्—विध mfn. of which kind, R.
यद्—वीर्य mfn. of which valour, MBh.
यद्—वृत्त n. anything that has occurred, event, adventure, Hariv.; Kathās.
any form of यद्, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 66.
यदि नाम, ‘if ever’
यदि चेत् (चेत् being added redundantly) = ‘if’ (e.g. यदि चेत् स्यात्, ‘if it should be’)
पुरा यदि = ‘before’ (e.g. पुरा यदि पश्यामि, ‘before that I see’)
य॑द्य् अ॑पि (rarely अपि यदि), ‘even if’, ‘although’ (followed by तथापि or तद् अपि or sometimes by no particle in the correlative clause)
यदि — यदि च-यद्य् अपि, ‘if — and if — if also’
य॑दि — य॑दि-वा, or य॑दि वा — य॑दि वा, or य॑दि वा — य॑दि, or यदि वा — वा, or वा — यदि वा, or यद् वा — यदि वा, ‘if — or if’, ‘whether — or’
य॑दि वा — न॑ वा, ‘whether — or not’
वा — यदि वा — यदि वा-तथापि, ‘whether — or — or — yet’
वा यदि = ‘or if’, ‘or rather’
यदि वा id. or = ‘yet’, ‘however’.
यदीय mfn. relating to whom, belonging to which or what, whose, Inscr.; Rājat.; BhP.
यद्रि॑यञ्च् (TS.) or यद्र्य᳙ञ्च् (MaitrS.), mfn. moving or turning in which direction, reaching whither.
यद्रियञ्च् यद्र्यञ्च्, यद्वन् See col. 1.
यद्रि॑यञ्च् (TS.) or यद्र्य᳙ञ्च् (MaitrS.), mfn. moving or turning in which direction, reaching whither.
यद्वन् m. pl. N. of a class of Ṛṣis, Pat.

य॑दु m. N. of an ancient hero (in the Veda often mentioned together with Turvaśa [or Turvasu] q.v., and described as preserved by Indra during an inundation; in epic poetry he is a son of Yayāti and brother of Puru and Turvasu, Kṛṣṇa being descended from Yadu, and Bharata and Kuru from Puru; Yadu is also called a son of Vasu, king of Cedi, or a son of Hary-aśva), RV.; MBh.; Hariv.; Pur.
N. of a country on the west of the Jumnā river (about Mathurā and Vṛndā-vana, over which Yadu ruled; according to others the Deccan or Southern peninsula of India), W.
pl. the people of Yadu or the descendants of king Yadu (cf. यादव), ib.
यादु॑ m. water, Naigh. i, 12.
यदु—कुलोद्वह m. ‘supporter of the Yadu family’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, Pañcar.
यदु—गिरीशाष्टोत्तर-शत n. N. of a Stotra.
यदु—ध्र m. N. of a Ṛṣi, Hariv.
यदु—नन्दन m. N. of Akrūra, VP.
यदु—नाथ m. ‘lord of the Yadus’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, L.
(also with मिश्र) N. of an author, Cat.
यदु—पति m. ‘lord of the Yadus’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, Cāṇ.
of various authors, Cat.
यदु—पुंगव m. a chief of the Yadus, MBh.
यदु—भरत m. N. of an author, Cat.
यदु—मणि m. N. of a man (father of Parama), ib.
यदु—वंश m. the family of Yadu, Cat.
यदु—वंश—काव्य n. N. of a poem.
यदु—वीर-मुख्य m. ‘leader of the Yadu heroes’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, MBh.
यदु—श्रेष्ठ m. ‘best of Yadus’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, Pañcar.
यदूद्वह m. ‘supporter of the Yadus’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, ib.
यद्वा f. = बुद्धि, perception, mind, intelligence (?), L.
या॑द्व mfn. belonging to the family of Yadu, RV.
या॑द्व m. a descendant of Yadu, ib.
याद्व See above.
याद्-राध्य᳙म् ind. (prob.) as far or as well or as quickly as possible, RV. ii, 38, 8.
याद्-राध्यम् See under 2. या॑त्.
याद—ईश m. ‘lord of marine animals’, the sea, L.
यादः in comp. for यादस्.
यादः—पति m. = यादईश, L.
N. of Varuṇa, L.
या॑दस् n. ‘close union (?)’, voluptuousness, VS.; TBr.
any large aquatic animal, sea monster, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (˚सां नाथः, ‘lord of aq˚ an˚’, N. of Varuṇa, L.; ˚सां प्रभुः id., Rājat.; ˚साम् पतिः id. or ‘the sea’, L.)
water, Naigh. i, 12
semen, Nir., Sch.
a river, Siddh.
यादस्—पति m. = यादसाम् पति, L.
या॑दुर mf(ई)n. embracing voluptuously (with copious effusion), RV. i, 126, 6 (Sāy. यादुरी = बहु-रेतो-युक्ता).
यादो in comp. for यादस्.
यादो—नाथ m. ‘lord of sea animals’, N. of Varuṇa, Ragh.
the sea, L.
यादो—निवास m. ‘abode of sea animals’, the sea, L.
यादव mf(ई)n. (fr. यदु) relating to or descended from Yadu, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
यादव m. a descendant of Y˚ (also pl.), ib.
N. of Kṛṣṇa, L.
N. of various authors (cf. comp.), Cat.
यादव n. a stock of cattle, L.
यादवी f. a female descendant of Y˚, MBh.; Hariv.
N. of Durgā, L.
यादव—कोश m. N. of a dictionary (= वैजयन्ती; cf. यादव-प्रकाश).
यादव—गिरि m. N. of a place
यादव—गिरि—माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
यादव—चम्पू f. N. of an artificial poem.
यादव—पण्डित m. N. of an author (also called यादव-व्यास).
यादव—पुत्र m. ‘son of Y˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, MBh.
यादव—प्रकाश m. N. of an ascetic and author (also called गोविन्द-दास), Cat.
of the author of the Vaijayantī (see यादव-कोश), ib.
यादव—प्रकाश—स्वामिन् m. N. of a poet, ib.
यादव—राघव-पाण्डवीय n.
यादव—राघवीय n. N. of two poems.
यादव—राय m. N. of a king, Inscr.
यादव—व्यास m. N. of an author, Cat.
यादव—शार्दूल m. ‘tiger or chief of the Y˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, MBh.
यादवाचार्य m. N. of a teacher, Cat.
यादवाभ्युदय m. ‘rise of the Y˚s’, N. of a history of Kṛṣṇa.
यादवेन्द्र m. ‘lord of the Y˚’, N. of Kṛṣṇa, Pañcar.
of various authors (also with भट्ट and पुरी), Cat.
यादवोदय m. ‘rise of the Yādavas’, N. of a drama.
यादवक m. pl. the descendants of Yadu, Hariv.
यादवी-पुत्र m. metron. of Yudhiṣṭhira, MBh.
यादायनि m. a patr. fr. यद्, Pat.
यादृक्ष mf(ई)n. (for यद्-दृ˚) looking or appearing like which, which like, as like (used correlatively to तादृक्ष, q.v.), Pāṇ. vi, 3, 90, Sch.
यादृग् in comp. for यादृश्.
यादृग्—गुण mfn. of whatever qualities, Mn. ix, 21.
यादृ॑श् mfn. (for यद्-दृश्; nom. in Veda यादृङ्, Pāṇ. vii, 1, 83; यादृक्, RV. v, 44, 6; loc. यादृश्मिन्, ib. 8), which like, as like, of whatever kind or nature, RV. &c. &c.
यादृक् कीदृ॑क् च, quale tale, TBr.
यादृ॑श mf(ई)n. = prec. ŚBr. &c. &c.
यादृश तादृश (Pañcat.) or यादृश-त्˚ (MBh.; Kathās.), ‘any one whatever’, ‘anybody whatsoever’.
